summary: Exposed local-first aom lifecycle commands through agentd and rootfs operator command registry without adding activation authority.
acceptance_evidence: aom search/show/verify/stage/explain operate against the pinned local registry snapshot.
aom stage reports staged_only=true, active=false and activation_prepared=false.
aom activate returns status=blocked until TASK-ECO-004 and TASK-ECO-005.
Rootfs operator command registry lists aom.* commands and does not expose shell.exec.

commands.summary: Alpha rootfs validation passed and verified aom.* command registry entries plus ecosystem registry snapshot.

blocked_shortcuts: aom activate does not activate artifacts in Wave 4.
aom stage does not create or mutate active artifact state.
agentd delegates resolver and staging behavior to agent_core::ecosystem.
No normal-mode shell command surface was added.
promotion_impact: Establishes a local-first aom operator surface while preserving install/stage != activate.
